svg.data-power-max-scope: heat dissipation with worst-case IOM and MDAs (SR-7 guide p94 Table 29)
svg.data-power-input-dc: -40 to -72 VDC into two DC PEM-3 (100 A breaker each), one -48 V / RTN pair per PEM-3; one PEM-3 carries the system, two give redundancy
svg.data-rated-voltage-dc: -40 to -72 VDC; PEM-3 4000 W at -40 to -72 VDC, 4600 W at -46 to -72 VDC
svg.data-power-input-ac: none on the chassis; an external split rectifier shelf (OmniOn L21 3HE20676AA, Eltek HM34J) feeds the PEM-3 terminals
svg.data-operating-temp: 5 C to 40 C; short-term -5 C to 55 C
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 77.6 dBA at low fan RPM (3300), 91.7 at high (6000), 99.6 at full (7900), with PEM-3s and Enhanced Fan Trays
svg.data-altitude: 60 m below to 1800 m above sea level at 40 C; 1800 to 4000 m at 30 C
